files: S4S - Giving ShoesDay + End of Year 2026 - client editing doc (Sydney, 19 Oct). This page is built from it.
Sydney's holiday end slide: V1 light blue or V2 dark blue. 9:16, S4S logo already in the top of the slide. CTA text in the open middle area; no extra logo.

Giving ShoesDay is 1 Dec. Goal: 2,500 kids, $50,000. End of Year runs 2 to 31 Dec. Goal: 5,000 kids, $100,000. $20 = one new pair of athletic shoes (two with a match). GSD match: dollar for dollar up to $25,000, pending confirmation.
tech: Client footage from Canto and Christe's 4EveryKid upload. Mixed sizes and frame rates: conform on import.
1080×1920. Frame rate = the majority of the clips.
Horizontal clips: center-crop to 9:16, faces in frame. No stretching.
All on-screen text exactly as written in Sydney's doc. Big, readable on a phone. S4S fonts (Buenos Aires titles, Roboto body).
checklist: Every on-screen line is word for word from Sydney's doc.
Giving ShoesDay is one word “ShoesDay”, capital S and D.
Text is big enough to read on a phone. Text size is this client's most common note.
Ends on Sydney's holiday end slide with the CTA in the open middle.
Result line is a separate text layer, easy to swap.

decisions.b: Use the goal-hit line for now: “2,500 kids. $50,000 raised. Promise kept!” If the goal is missed: “You helped raise $[X] for kids, and our CMO is taking the pie anyway!” Sydney confirms after the GSD totals.

client_note: Why this matters: Giving ShoesDay (1 Dec) is Soles4Souls' biggest day of the year. Sydney wrote every line herself: keep it joy themed and positive.
